services.value: The company provides certified water testing services for residential, real estate/mortgage requirements, and commercial/business water, including testing for bacteria (coliforms & E. coli), lead, nitrates/nitrites, water hardness & pH, sulfur, chlorine, arsenic, and an aesthetics panel (e.g., iron, TDS, copper, tannins). It also offers chemical cleaning and system flushing for well systems and pipes, and provides sample handling with results delivered by email.
